messages.subject: how to re-use ..density..
parts:
Dear all,

I plot the histogram as the following command shows:

x <- rnorm(1000)
x <- melt(x)
p <- ggplot(x, aes(x=value))
p <- p + geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..), stat="bin")


I would like to add labels.
Something like this:
p <- p + geom_text(aes(x=value, y=..density.. + adjust ,label=value), data=x)

I wonder that is it possible to re-use the values of ..density.. ?

Best wishes,
Guangchuang Yu

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: how to re-use ..density..
parts:
Hi Guangchuang,
I'm not sure if you can reuse it. But you can easily recreate it. But

geom_text(aes(x=value, y=..density.. + adjust ,label=value)) will not
work, because there are many more values of "value" than there are of
"density".

Maybe you want something like

p + geom_text(aes(label = gsub("+0", "", round(..density..,
digit=2)), x=value, y=..density.. + 0.006), stat="bin", size=3)

?

Best,
Ista

Hi,

Thanks for your quick reply!

Your command works, but I still have a question.

I know that in

p + geom_text(aes(label = gsub("+0", "", round(..density..,
digit=2)), x=value, y=..density.. + 0.006), stat="bin", size=3)

x=value is require for calculating ..density.., but what if I only want a subset of *value* to be label ?

like this:

labs <- data.frame(v1=sample(x$value, 10), v2=paste("X", 1:10, sep=""))
p + geom_text(aes(label = labs$v2, x=labs$v1, y=..density.. + 0.006), stat="bin", size=3)

Many thanks for your help!

Best wishes,
